applicantVariants.label: Under 18 (Class CP permit / Class D provisional)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Next business day; only the failed section (Road Signs or Road Rules) must be retaken
retake.retakeFee: $10 permit fee is nonrefundable and is charged for each test attempt

gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: Class CP held at least 12 months and 1 day (minors)
gdl.nightCurfew: Class D holders may not drive 12 a.m.-5 a.m.
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: immediate family only; next 6 months: 1 passenger under 21; after 12 months: up to 3 passengers under 21

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and U.S. citizenship or lawful presence (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Minors: notarized Certificate of School Enrollment (Form DS-1) and completed driver education / ADAP certificate
process.realIdNotes: Georgia licenses are REAL ID compliant (gold star). Bring one identity document, one SSN document, and two Georgia residency documents.
process.visionStandard: At least 20/60 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses, and at least 140 degrees horizontal field of vision

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 15 points in any 24-month period (age 21+); drivers under 18 are suspended at 4 points in 12 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if unable, for stopped emergency, utility, and DOT vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: As posted, reduced when lights are flashing or children are present (commonly 25 mph)

references.label: Teen Driving Laws (Joshua's Law)
references.citation: GA DDS Teen Driving Laws FAQs; O.C.G.A. § 40-5-24
